marketSnapshots.reason: Price worsened again and now requires about a 61.4% raw hit rate. PRIME still lacks a robust current distribution supporting that price.

London's role remains strong, but Michael Penix Jr. is making his first start back from ACL surgery and there is no current independent probability stack establishing the roughly 59% hit rate required by -144.
Plus money is not enough by itself. No current independent Week 3 catch-distribution estimate was verified for this threshold.
The 80.6-yard consensus point projection is essentially on top of the 80+ threshold. PRIME will not recommend an Over from a sub-yard projection gap at -108.
Three-plus passing touchdowns is a high-variance alternate market. Terrell's absence improves the matchup but does not establish a fair probability sufficient to justify +293.
